notes:
Console 2.3.28 and teacher app 1.20.6. The O-Level final score is now A2 (20%) + A3 (80%).
- Marks grid shows A2 and A3, then the weighted Final and the Grade, updating as you type
- Final = A2 x 20% + A3 x 80%, never the two marks added together
- Half a card stays incomplete: a dash instead of a false zero and no grade until both marks are in
- Marks outside 0-100 are refused; the raw A2 and A3 marks are stored separately and the final is always worked out from them
- Old marks keep their own assessment and are never relabelled; schools without A2/A3 carry on as before
- The teacher app shows each learner's A2, A3, final and grade on one line while entering marks
